name: Emirates Palace, Mandarin Oriental

address.street: West - Corniche Rd - Abu Dhabi - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: This isn't just a hotel—it's a palace that redefines luxury with gold-plated everything and its own private beach stretching nearly a mile along the Arabian Gulf.
whats_special: The Emirates Palace is one of the most expensive hotels ever built, costing $3 billion to construct. It features 114 domes, uses real gold and marble throughout, and has its own helipad. The hotel sits on 200 acres of pristine beachfront and houses the famous Palace Cappuccino topped with 23-karat gold flakes.
pro_tip: Book the signature Gold Cappuccino experience at Le Café—it's Instagram gold and costs around $25, but you'll be sipping actual gold flakes while overlooking the palace gardens.
dont_miss: The stunning Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is just 15 minutes away—one of the world's largest mosques with 82 domes and capacity for 40,000 worshippers. Also explore the nearby Louvre Abu Dhabi, the first universal museum in the Arab world, featuring masterpieces under its iconic geometric dome.
pros: Iconic palace architecture with opulent Arabian design and gold accents
Private beach with pristine white sand and crystal-clear waters
World-class spa and wellness facilities with traditional treatments
Exceptional dining options including award-winning restaurants
Prime location offering stunning views of Abu Dhabi's coastline
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers
